e2ee.title: End-to-End Encryption
e2ee.lockedDescription: End-to-end encryption ensures not even NexoMind can read your entries. Available exclusively on the Premium+ plan.
e2ee.readyDescription: Encrypt your journal with a passphrase only you know. Your entries will be unreadable to anyone without it, including us.
e2ee.disclosure: Your entries are encrypted with a key derived from your passphrase. Even we cannot read your journal. If you forget your passphrase, your data is permanently unrecoverable.

therapistBridge.title: Bridge to your therapist.
therapistBridge.subtitle: Generate a structured brief from your recent reflections to share with your mental health professional.
therapistBridge.unavailable: This feature is not available yet.
therapistBridge.premiumSubtitle: Share structured insights with your therapist. Available on Premium.
therapistBridge.disclaimerNeeded: Before using Therapist Bridge, please review and accept the disclaimer.
therapistBridge.disclaimerBody:
This feature generates an AI-assisted summary of your journal entries intended as supplementary context for a licensed mental health professional.

It is NOT a clinical assessment, diagnosis, or treatment recommendation.

The generated brief may contain inaccuracies. Your therapist should use their professional judgment when interpreting this document.

You control which entries are included and can redact any entry before generating the PDF.
therapistBridge.disclaimerAck: I understand that this is not a clinical document and that I am sharing AI-generated analysis with my therapist at my own discretion.
therapistBridge.generateDescription: NexoMind will analyze your last 30 days of journal entries and produce a structured brief covering themes, cognitive patterns, mood trends, and representative entries.
therapistBridge.insufficientData: You need at least 3 analyzed journal entries in the last 30 days to generate a brief.
therapistBridge.e2eeBlocked: Therapist briefs cannot be generated when end-to-end encryption is active. Briefs must be generated on-device.
therapistBridge.redactHint: Uncheck entries you want to exclude from the PDF.
therapistBridge.downloaded: Your therapist brief PDF is downloading.
therapistBridge.reminderDescription: Set a reminder to share this brief with your therapist before your next session.
therapistBridge.reminderSet: Reminder set for {{hours}} hours from now.
therapistBridge.reminderBody: Remember to share your therapist brief before your next session.
crisisDetection.title: Crisis Detection
crisisDetection.localeUnavailable: Crisis detection is not yet available in your region. We are working on locale-appropriate resources and will notify you when it becomes available.
crisisDetection.setupDescription: An optional safety feature that monitors your journal entries for signs of acute distress. When triggered, it surfaces crisis resources - it never contacts anyone automatically.
crisisDetection.disclaimerBody:
This feature uses pattern-based analysis to detect potential signs of crisis in your journal entries.

It is NOT a substitute for professional crisis intervention.
It will NEVER automatically contact emergency services or any other person.
It may produce false positives or miss genuine crises.

If you are in immediate danger, please contact emergency services directly.
crisisDetection.disclaimerAck: I understand that crisis detection is not a substitute for professional help and that it will never automatically contact anyone on my behalf.
crisisDetection.explanationBody:
NexoMind analyzes your journal entries for patterns associated with acute distress, including specific language patterns and voice biomarker changes.

When the signal exceeds a threshold, you will see a card with crisis resources. You choose whether to act on it.

No data is shared externally. No one is contacted without your explicit action.
crisisDetection.optInBody: By activating crisis detection, you consent to NexoMind analyzing your entries for distress patterns. You can disable this at any time from Settings.
crisisDetection.activeDescription: Your journal entries are being monitored for signs of acute distress. If triggered, you will see a card with crisis resources.
crisisDetection.trustedMessage: Hi, this is a message from NexoMind on behalf of {{name}}. They wanted to let you know they could use some support right now.
crisisCard.title: You matter
crisisCard.body: Something in your recent reflection caught our attention. You do not have to face this alone. Here are some people who can help right now.
crisisCard.footer: NexoMind will never contact anyone on your behalf without your action.
